snapshot.title: ForgeaX Studio
snapshot.text:
Welcome · Language · Connect
Choose a game
Enter home
Welcome to Forgeax Studio!
Just tell Forge "make a game about X" — it plans, writes the code, and shows your game running live.
Language
中文
English
Connect a model
Pick one way to connect — you can change it later in Settings.
Use an API Key

Use a local CLI
Connect a local claude-code / codex / cursor-agent.
